resources.string: Sends Back, so one press of Back closes the keyboard and goes back. While the Sym panel is open, in the Smart Launcher search field and for a moment after you press Back, TitanKeys sees the keys you press. While you type, it keeps the touchpad on the keys when a notification shows at the top of the screen. It can\'t read your screen, and it doesn\'t keep or send anything.
The words are exported, but the favourites couldn\'t be added. Try again.
The words are imported, but the favourites couldn\'t be kept. Try again.
Copy something and it shows up here for an hour.
To pin a clip, press Enter, then the key under it.
Press the key under a clip to pin or unpin it
Press Backspace or Clear again. Pinned clips stay.

Clipboard. What you copied in the last hour, and the clips you pinned. Press the key under a clip to paste it. Swipe up or down for more, and left or right for Pinned. Enter pins, Backspace clears, and Alt goes back.
Older clips: press Sym, then A
To use names from your contacts, allow Contacts for TitanKeys here.

resources.string: TitanKeys can use Android\'s Accessibility service to make Back and a few keys work better. It\'s optional.
Back: when you press Back, TitanKeys sends it on for you, so one press closes the keyboard and goes back in the app.
Keys: at these times only, it sees which keys you press before the app does:
while the Sym panel is open, so Enter and Backspace turn its pages instead of reaching the app;
in the Smart Launcher search field, so holding a key for a symbol and pressing Shift or Alt twice work there;
for a moment after you press Back, so your next press of Back reaches the app.
Touchpad: while you type, it keeps the touchpad on the keys when a notification shows at the top of the screen.
It can\'t read your screen or the text in your apps.
It doesn\'t keep or send the keys it sees. They\'re used on your phone straight away, then forgotten.
If you say no: TitanKeys still types and swipes. Back may take two presses, and those keys work as they would without TitanKeys. You can turn it on later in Settings > Setup.
